thread:
rachel: Planning an edge-cache eviction simulation for na-west on Fri 06/18 23:00-23:30 UTC. Purpose: validate cache-repopulation, KV fallback behavior, and the autoscaler response when cache miss storm happens. We'll run a controlled eviction of 60% of hot prefixes. Internal SLO leniency tag will be applied. Please ack if you can't make the window. :mag:

dez: Ack. Which prefixes and generator are we using?

rachel: Target prefixes are the top-500 hot prefixes for na-west (runbook picks snapshot at T-1h). Traffic generator: synth-bot/generator-v3 with gradual ramp. Steps: evict -> 5% traffic -> 25% -> 60% -> observe -> recover.

ton y: (typo) I can take KV ownership. I'll instrument miss-rate and backend QPS metrics. If miss-rate > 40% for 5m we pause.

grace: I'll add dashboard annotations and mute internal pagers for 40 minutes. External alerts remain. Also adding a short-lived synthetic monitor to validate first-byte latency on affected prefixes.

oncall-sre: I'll be oncall. Preflight checklist?

rachel: Preflight gist:
```
# export current hot-prefixes snapshot
redwood-cache list-hot --region na-west --top 500 > /tmp/hot-prefixes.txt
# verify kv replication and cold-read latency
redwood-metrics query "kv_read_latency{region=\"na-west\"}"
```

synth-bot: Calendar event created: "NA-WEST edge-cache eviction sim" Fri 06/18 23:00-23:30 UTC. Attendees: eng-sre, eng-runtime, obs. Job IDs: gen-196543-evict, monitor-196543-pre.
notes: We will monitor for token spikes, backend QPS surge, and transient 5xxs. Rollback plan: restore evicted prefixes snapshot and throttle generator. Command: redwood-cache restore --region na-west --from /tmp/hot-prefixes.txt --reason rollback_eviction
extra: rachel: If we hit >2x p99 or any customer 5xxs, rollback immediately and escalate. dez: I'll run a small canary (2% traffic) for 5m after eviction before scaling generator. synth-bot: Eviction completed at 23:05 UTC, starting 2% canary. monitor-bot: Canary metrics: miss-rate +12%, p95 +14ms, errors 0. No customer errors. Proceed to ramp.
final: tony: At 23:18 we saw a transient surge in backend QPS causing queueing on read-replicas. We paused ramp and applied read-rate limiter on generator (cap 2500 rps). Post-mitigation: queued requests drained, p95 normalized. grace: Postmortem action items: add read-replica autoscale policy, include prefix-eviction test in preflight, and bake a restore playbook. oncall-sre: Closing simulation; runbook updated: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/eng-sre/edge-cache-eviction-sim#postmortem
